signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: For internal employees only; no external registration.
signIn.emailStepSubtitle: Enter your employee email to continue.
signIn.invalidEmployee: Invalid employee account. Self-registration is not available. Please contact the Learning Guide administrator.

activate.title: Set your password
activate.subtitle: This link can be used once and expires 48 hours after it was sent.
activate.successBody: You can now sign in with your email and the password you just set.
activate.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Please use the link from your activation email.
activate.expiredBody: Activation links are valid for 48 hours. Please contact the Learning Guide administrator for a new one.
activate.invalidBody: This activation link has already been used or has been replaced. Please ask an administrator to resend the activation email.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your employee email. If the account is active and verified, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that email belongs to an active employee account, a reset link has been sent.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. The link can be used once.
reset.successBody: Your password has been reset. Please sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidBody: This reset link has already been used or has not been recognised. Please request a new one.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links are valid for 2 hours. Please request a new one.
reset.usedBody: This reset link has already been used. Please request a new one.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.subtitle: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
changePassword.success: Your password has been changed. Please sign in again.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.

course.title: Course
course.description: This is the default landing page after sign-in. Course business functions are defined in a separate PRD.

placeholder.title: {menu}

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to access this page.

employees.title: Employee Account
employees.subtitle: Manage backoffice employee accounts, roles and access permissions.
employees.newSubtitle: Create a new employee account and assign their role and status.
employees.editSubtitle: Update this employee's role and status.
employees.hintActivation: An activation email will be sent to this email address. Once activated, the email address cannot be changed.
employees.hintEmailVerified: This email address has been activated and cannot be changed.
employees.empty: No employee accounts match the current search and filters.
employees.hintEmailLocked: A verified email address cannot be changed.
employees.bootstrapLocked: The protected administrator account cannot be deactivated, demoted or deleted.
